exposure: antimicrobial use during the perinatal period
cohort: The study included 101 children diagnosed with CMPA and 90 children without CMPA or any other allergy.
finding: Breastfeeding duration and the use of antimicrobials during the gestational stage were statistically significantly associated with CMPA.
gest_age: Gestational age was included as a variable but was not found to be associated with CMPA.
